sections.shortTitle: Bolan Medical College Board of Governors Act 1990
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 1990
ACT III OF 1990
BOLAN MEDICAL COLLEGE (BOARD OF GOVERNORS) ACT, 1990
An Act to provide for the
establishment of Board of Governors for the Bolan Medical College in the
Balochistan Province
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 15th February, 1990]
No. PAB/Legis. III (18)/90, dated
15-2-1990.--The Bolan Medical College (Board of Governors) Bill, 1990 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 4th February, 1990 and
assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Bolan Medical College (Board of Governors) Act, 1990.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 4th February, 1990 and
assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of

2. Definitions: -In this Act, unless the context otherwise
requires:--
(a)
"Board" means the Board of Governors established under section 3 of
this Act;
(b)
"Chairman" means the Chairman of the Board;
(c)
"College" means the Bolan Medical College and includes any hospital
attached thereto;
(d)
"Government" means the Government of Balochistan;
(e)
"Member" means any member of the Board and includes the Chairman.

'College Fund" vested in the Board.
(2) All receipts of the liege from any source whatsoever shall
constitute the College Fund which shall be applied, subject to and rules made

9. Return and statements.--(1)
As soon as may be after the close of every financial year but not later than
the last day of September next following, the Board shall submit to Government
a report of the conduct of its affairs for that year.
(2) Government may require the
Board to furnish it with--
(a)
any report, return, statement, estimate, statistics or other
information regarding any matter under control of the Board or on any subject
with which the Board is concerned; or
(b)
any document or copy thereof in the charge or under the
control of the Board.
